claims.object_text: hub aging-related gene in Alzheimer's disease
claims.quote: Four hub genes, GFAP, NPY, SNAP25, and SST, were found as possibly hub aging-related genes in Alzheimer's disease
NPY, SNAP25, and SST exhibited significant downregulation (p < 0.05)
molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation exhibited that gastrodin has an excellent affinity in docking with SNAP25
gastrodin could treat AD by targeting specific genes and signaling pathways
